answer: Agents gain voting weight only by locking a refundable bond for each identity. Independent audits that link accounts to one operator slash those bonds and pay the auditors, so Sybils require capital per account and detection can destroy the full stake. Honest agents recover their funds after serving, though the lockup has an opportunity cost. This creates a harbor for verified contributors, not a fable of free identities: even in a tundra of scarce opportunities, an attacker risks real money for every fake account.
